caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a round plate or shallow bowl with a wide rim and a decorative handle at the top. The plate is rendered in shades of gray with pencil shading to suggest curvature and depth. The handle has an ornate, geometric shape and contains a diamond-shaped space with an intertwined monogram, the letters "RG" written in a decorative script. The same monogram is also displayed in the upper left corner of the drawing, enclosed within a square. In the lower right corner, there is a small outline sketch showing the side profile of the plate with its dimensions (4 3/4 inches in diameter and 1 1/2 inches in height) noted beside it. The background of the drawing is an off-white color, and the rectangles enclosing the primary and detail views are drawn with fine lines. The artist's name, "Hester Duxbury," is written below the plate.
title: Silver Porringer
